methods.label: Supplement and bisect
methods.explanation: Angles \(\angle BEF\) and \(\angle EFD\) are same-side interior angles, so \(\angle BEF=180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ\). Since \(EG\) bisects \(\angle BEF\), \(\angle GEF=110^\circ\div2=55^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 parallel-line properties and the definition of an angle bisector.
